triageTaxonomy.label: Bug
triageTaxonomy.description: A reproducible behavior violates a documented contract.

triageTaxonomy.label: Feature
triageTaxonomy.description: A bounded capability request with a user-visible outcome.

triageTaxonomy.label: Documentation
triageTaxonomy.description: A correction or missing explanation that does not change behavior.

triageTaxonomy.label: Question
triageTaxonomy.description: A request for clarification that may become documentation.

triageTaxonomy.label: Performance
triageTaxonomy.description: A measured resource, latency, or scale concern with a reproducible boundary.

triageTaxonomy.label: Compatibility
triageTaxonomy.description: A supported-runtime, schema, adapter, or platform mismatch.

triageTaxonomy.label: Security
triageTaxonomy.description: A possible vulnerability or trust-boundary failure; use the private route for details.

triageTaxonomy.label: Adopter feedback
triageTaxonomy.description: A consented report from someone evaluating the documented workflow.

triageTaxonomy.label: Contributor
triageTaxonomy.description: A contribution, maintainer-capacity, or onboarding signal.

triageTaxonomy.label: Roadmap
triageTaxonomy.description: A backlog sequencing or explicit investment decision.

triageTaxonomy.label: Governance
triageTaxonomy.description: A process, ownership, or public decision-record concern.

adopterTemplate.privacyInstructions: Submit only public or explicitly authorized synthetic material; remove source bodies, private repository URLs, credentials, personal data, and proprietary architecture before publication.

records.signal: The repository needs a public, consent-based feedback path before making adoption or traction claims; local deterministic artifacts remain the only current evidence.

decisions.rationale: Keep the feedback loop public, consent-based, anonymized, and local; do not add source upload or usage telemetry.
No external adopter or contributor records are present in this snapshot, so the project must not claim traction or representative adoption.

provenance.reference: M-004 public adopter and contributor feedback-loop issue; no external source
provenance.transformation: The snapshot encodes the public process and one clearly synthetic maintainer baseline; it does not copy external messages, source bodies, private repositories, or telemetry.
